query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_users,
  SUM(CASE WHEN googleId IS NOT NULL AND passwordHash IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as google_only,
  SUM(CASE WHEN googleId IS NOT NULL AND passwordHash IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as google_and_email,
  SUM(CASE WHEN googleId IS NULL AND passwordHash IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as email_only,
  SUM(CASE WHEN emailVerified = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as verified_email,
  SUM(CASE WHEN createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as last_7_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as last_30_days
FROM app_users;
